_rule: Builders may write up to 'built'. ONLY the verifier agent writes 'verified'. See AGENTS.md.

features.name: Harness, memory vault, governance docs
features.acceptance: init.sh and verify.sh run clean; memory_index.py builds and answers a query; all six governance docs exist

features.name: Xcode project scaffold
features.acceptance: SwiftUI app builds for iOS 17 min and launches in the iOS 26.5 simulator showing a real first screen

features.name: Design system (tokens, glass surfaces, motion)
features.acceptance: No hardcoded colour/font/spacing anywhere; token gallery renders; light-independent dark palette matches DEC-002

features.name: PII detection engine
features.acceptance: Detects PAN, Aadhaar, IFSC, card, email, phone, GSTIN, and NL person/place/org names with bounding boxes; unit tests over a fixture corpus pass

features.name: Irreversible redaction core
features.acceptance: Test OCRs our own exported output and asserts the secret string is UNRECOVERABLE; EXIF/GPS/PDF metadata stripped

features.name: SwiftData persistence (local only)
features.acceptance: Documents persist across launch; no iCloud, no network; delete removes all derived files

features.name: Scan / import
features.acceptance: VisionKit capture plus photo and PDF import; limited photo access only; purpose strings explain why

features.name: Redaction editor
features.acceptance: Tap detected spans to toggle; draw manual boxes; undo/redo; signature scanline animation honours reduceMotion

features.name: Export (PNG / PDF)
features.acceptance: Share sheet export; free tier PNG single page, Pro multi-page PDF; output passes the irreversibility test

features.name: Library
features.acceptance: Lists past documents with thumbnails; search; swipe delete purges files

features.name: RevenueCat paywall and entitlements
features.acceptance: Test Store purchase completes and flips entitlement; Restore Purchases button present; EULA and Privacy links visible; price, period and auto-renewal stated

features.name: Onboarding and bundled sample document
features.acceptance: A reviewer reaches a redacted result in under 30 seconds from a cold launch with zero setup

features.name: Accessibility pass
features.acceptance: VoiceOver navigates every screen and every detected span; largest Dynamic Type does not clip; reduceMotion honoured

features.name: App Store Connect record and IAP products
features.acceptance: Real (non-Test-Store) API key in use; RevenueCat shows a Store API call — MILESTONE 4

features.name: TestFlight build
features.acceptance: Build processed, installed on a real device, sandbox purchase verified, human sign-off given

features.name: App Store submission
features.acceptance: asc validate passes with zero blockers; submitted on or before 2026-09-05
